t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in specific colour pairs. Certain colours lead to the light forest and the others lead to the dark forest. The appearance of the gnome is irrelevant to the decisions. Through this we have to figure out which one lead to the forest with more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: I'll try to keep this as simple as possible.The gnomes always appear in certain colour pairs:Orange  &  BrownGreen    &  PinkRed       &  YellowBlue      &   PurpleThe positions of the gnomes may change (left or right side) but they stay in these pairs.The gnomes colours on the left (orange, green, red, blue) will lead you to the bright forest which has a red basket, the gnomes colours on the right (brown, pink, yellow, purple) will lead you to the dark forest which has a yellow basket.You will need to go to one of these forests by following the specific colour set of gnomes to see which forest offers you more mushrooms (dark or bright). The appearance of the gnome (height, hat type etc) is irrelevant to the amount of mushrooms.
